rules: Uptrend: the pole top is a higher high (above the previous swing high, zigzag 6%) and the flag low a higher low (above the previous swing low); 21-day average rising, 200-day average rising. Pole: >= 15% rise in <= 15 sessions from the swing low to the highest high. Pause (3-25 sessions): Flag = highs and lows drifting down, Pennant = highs falling and lows rising, Rectangle = flat box;  falling or flat highs, pullback <= half the pole and <= 12%, no close above the pole top, close above the 200-day average. Room: the nearest earlier swing high above the entry must be >= 0.8 x the pole away (or none). Tight: flag range <= 8%; volume dries up in the flag (< 0.75 x the pole, < the 50-day average); breakout candle >= 1.5 x the 50-day average volume and the flag's biggest. Early = the pole started within 4% of the 200-day average (fresh uptrend); established = 50 > 200-day average, both rising. Trigger = the flag's top line; stop = flag low (incl. the breakout day); exit = first daily close below the 21-day EMA (pole target shown for reference).
backtest: With room >= 0.8 x pole to the next resistance (22 Nov 2026): 1,151 trades, +3.2% a trade (PF 1.79), last 2 years +2.4% (PF 1.67), worst portfolio fall -26%. Tight + volume rules alone (22 Nov 2026, 2,183 NSE stocks 2016-26): 2,979 trades, buy the breakout close, stop flag low, exit on a close below the 21-day EMA: +2.8% a trade (PF 1.75); last 1 year +0.8% (PF 1.21), last 2 years +0.9% (1.22), 5 years +1.8% (1.45). Buying next day above the breakout high instead: +1.7% (PF 1.37), worse. Earlier, all flags: Tested 22 Nov 2026 (2,421 NSE stocks, 30,360 breakouts 2016-26): flag-low stop + exit on a close below the 21-day EMA +2.2% a trade (profit factor 1.71) vs +1.4% (1.34) selling at the pole target; breakout-day-low stop worse (stopped 81%). Rectangles +7.3% (PF 3.2), pennants +2.3%, flags +2.0%; established uptrends +2.7% vs new +1.9%. Last 2 years -0.6% a trade and portfolio drawdowns of 55-70% - watch only.
